entries.message: Fix - Preserve deleted provider identity during replay
entries.author: Lasikiewicz
details: Use the removed watch row's native Plex, Emby, or Jellyfin item ID to suppress synchronous played acknowledgements while retaining the user's oldest Plembfin date.

entries.message: Fix - Reject duplicate played-flag history
entries.author: Lasikiewicz
details: Treat Plex, Emby, and Jellyfin played-flag notifications as acknowledgements when Plembfin already has watched history for the item.

entries.message: Fix - Suppress Plex played echoes before history insert
entries.author: Lasikiewicz
details: Keep removed Plex watch dates from returning when Plex acknowledges Plembfin's own canonical watched-state write.

entries.message: Fix - Keep deleted provider watch dates removed
entries.author: Lasikiewicz
details: Prevent Plex, Emby, and Jellyfin library snapshots from recreating a watch date the user removed while an older Plembfin watch remains canonical.

entries.message: Fix - Retain matched identity through watch dedupe
entries.author: Lasikiewicz
details: Same-date watch cleanup now preserves the newest Plembfin provider IDs so correctly watched episodes remain in their show.

entries.message: Fix - Keep show details current and merges reversible
entries.author: Lasikiewicz
details: Show detail pages now read committed episode rows directly after manual watch actions.
The Merge menu lists recorded merges and can restore a wrongly merged show.

entries.message: Fix - Preserve matched show identity on manual watches
entries.author: Lasikiewicz
details: Manual episode watches now inherit the provider IDs established by Fix Match, preventing watched episodes from being hidden in a parallel show cluster.

entries.message: Fix - Keep manual watch state authoritative
entries.author: Lasikiewicz
details: Prevent delayed provider callbacks from reversing a watched or unwatched choice made in Plembfin.

entries.message: Fix - Finalize manual watch authority after sync
entries.author: Lasikiewicz
details: Keep explicit Plembfin watched actions canonical after remote callbacks complete.

entries.message: Fix - Preserve manual watched authority
entries.author: Lasikiewicz
details: Keep Plembfin manual watched actions authoritative after remote sync replacement echoes.

entries.message: Fix - Align dashboard and TV history behavior
entries.author: Lasikiewicz
details: Hide zero-watched TV groups from the watched-history library while preserving their canonical detail state.
Make Now Playing episode and progress accents follow the selected appearance theme.
Restore Part Watched cards when an unchanged refresh replaces the loading placeholder.
Add regression coverage and document the dashboard, TV library, and planned first-run onboarding flow.

entries.message: Fix - Prevent Plex watched-state rollbacks
entries.author: Lasikiewicz
details: Part Watched episode labels and progress now follow the active theme accent.
Recent positive-offset Plex watch rollbacks are repaired without hiding later deliberate unwatches.

entries.message: Fix - Stabilize watched state and dashboard reloads
entries.author: Lasikiewicz
details: Manual watched changes now persist across rematched episode aliases and fresh show reloads.
Part Watched reloads now cancel stale requests and recover cleanly from timeouts or failures.

entries.message: Fix - Record explicit manual watch transitions
entries.author: Lasikiewicz
details: Manual episode watches now survive reloads while resync-only records remain idempotent.
Refresh the watched-action browser module and stabilize identity test setup.

entries.message: Fix - Repair stale manual watch history
entries.author: Lasikiewicz
details: Manual release-day watch marks now remain watched after reloads when an older build left playstate and history out of sync.

entries.message: Fix - Preserve manual watches across rematched aliases
entries.author: Lasikiewicz
details: Resolve canonical playstate from the newest related provider-id alias instead of trusting an older exact key
Record a fresh manual watched transition when a release-day watch supersedes a newer canonical unwatch
Cover the Silo S03E03 rematch and manual-watch regression paths

entries.message: Fix - Keep tracker rewatches canonical after rematch
entries.author: Lasikiewicz
details: Record a fresh watched transition when an older watched alias coexists with a newer unwatched canonical pointer
Prevent Trakt reconciliation cache rebuilds from reverting manually restored episodes
Add the Silo S03E03 provider-id rematch regression

entries.message: Fix - Prevent tracker polls reversing force sync
entries.author: Lasikiewicz
details: Publish hydrated Trakt intents before local Force Sync work and retry wrong provider IDs with cached title-derived identities
Keep tracker snapshots and outbound aliases ordered without treating failed writes as observed remote baselines
Apply watched and unwatched local mutations atomically, with rollback-safe synchronous repository primitives
Serialize cross-process media-server state writes by canonical title identity and fence expired lease owners
Hold stale Trakt changes for re-check while allowing genuine changes after the protection window expires
Cover remove-add gaps, split processes, wrong-ID aliases, sparse metadata, lease theft, rollback, and safety holds

entries.message: Fix - Preserve resume progress and prioritize local sync
entries.author: Lasikiewicz
details: Keep fresh partial playback in Plembfin when Emby or Jellyfin return Played false or stale dates, while preserving newer explicit unwatches
Complete Plex, Emby, and Jellyfin detail Force Sync writes before a separate two-worker Trakt phase so cloud history cannot hold the local worker pool
Keep explicit destination pushes Trakt-free and persist one truthful combined result after both phases
Stop queued Trakt items on cancellation while allowing active canonical remove/add replays to finish safely
Cover stale acknowledgements, delayed echoes, local-first ordering, partial outcomes, and cancellation with regressions

entries.message: Fix - Make resume and source-of-truth sync reliable
entries.author: Lasikiewicz
details: Keep Plex-sourced resume items visible and correctly ordered in Emby Continue Watching without making old progress look newly played
Recover interrupted sync counters, aggregate overlapping process activity safely, and clear orphaned progress after restart
Preserve each episode's real watched or unwatched Plembfin state during show-level source-of-truth sync
Prevent metadata or telemetry updates from reviving an older watched state over a newer unwatch
Keep destination-specific Force Sync operations from changing unselected Trakt history

entries.message: Fix - Preserve matching resume acknowledgements
entries.author: Lasikiewicz
details: Keep shared Part Watched progress when Emby or Jellyfin reports the same propagated position without a timestamp.
Continue honoring newer explicit unwatched decisions and reject mismatched timestamp-less positions.

entries.message: Fix - Retain newer resume progress
entries.author: Lasikiewicz
details: Let a newer partial-play position supersede an older unwatched marker when a live session stops.
Preserve explicit newer unwatched and watched decisions, with regression coverage for timestamp precedence.

entries.message: Fix - Protect resume progress and malformed imports
entries.author: Lasikiewicz
details: Keep Part Watched entries when Jellyfin acknowledges an outbound resume update with Played=false.
Block and repair malformed automatic episode imports, including uncertain titles that still carry series provider IDs.

entries.message: Fix - Align episode history identities
entries.author: Lasikiewicz
details: Episode history now prefers series-level provider IDs, reuses canonical show artwork, and resolves missing titles without requiring Fix Match.

entries.message: Feature - Add spoiler controls and searchable sync activity
entries.author: Lasikiewicz
details: Hide unwatched episode artwork and synopses by default, and add live Sync Activity search, numbered pagination, clearer disabled-state reporting, and neutral activity borders.
